name: CoinGecko
description: View top cryptocurrency prices live, crypto charts, market cap, and trading volume. Discover today’s trending coins, top crypto gainers and losers in the market such as Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana, BNB, XRP, Hyperliquid, and more. You can also compare them side by side in a table.

server.name: coingecko-mcp-app
server.title: CoinGecko
server.description: MCP server exposing CoinGecko cryptocurrency market data (prices, market caps, volume) as tools and widgets.

protocolMetadata.instructions: Route crypto requests to the right tool: get-coin-markets for current price/market data on specific coins or a top-N leaderboard; compare-coins when the user wants to compare or contrast 2–4 specific coins side by side (phrasing like "compare", "vs", "versus", "contrast", e.g. "BTC vs ETH") — prefer it over get-coin-markets for these; get-coin-market-chart for a single coin's price history / chart over a range (renders an interactive chart widget); get-coin-history for a coin's price, market cap and volume on a specific past date (a point-in-time snapshot); get-coin-info for what a coin *is* — its description, categories/sectors, official links and launch date (project background, not prices); get-trending for what's hot right now; get-categories for how crypto sectors/narratives (DeFi, Layer 1, memes, AI, RWA…) are performing — a ranked leaderboard of categories by market cap or 24h change (sectors/themes, not individual coins like get-trending and not the whole market like get-global-market); get-global-market for overall market health (total market cap, dominance); get-top-gainers-losers for what's pumping or dumping today (requires a Pro key); get-crypto-news for recent crypto news headlines — global, or filtered to one coin — presented verbatim, never summarized as bullish/bearish (not for what a coin is, use get-coin-info, and not for hot coins, use get-trending); search-coins to resolve an ambiguous ticker or name to a CoinGecko id before calling the others. Map user tickers and names to CoinGecko ids yourself (e.g. BTC → bitcoin). None of these tools give financial advice — always present the data neutrally and never recommend buying, selling, or holding.

tool.name: get-coin-markets
tool.title: Get coin market data
tool.description: Get current market data (price, market cap, 24h volume, market cap rank) for a list of CoinGecko coin ids, or for the top N coins by market cap, and display it in a visual widget. Provide either ids or topN, not both. Use this when the user asks for the price or market data of specific coins, or for a top-N leaderboard by market cap. To compare or contrast 2–4 specific coins (e.g. "BTC vs ETH"), use compare-coins instead. Not for historical prices (use get-coin-market-chart) and not financial advice.

_published_faq.name: How do I add CoinGecko to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add CoinGecko to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.coingecko.com/mcp.

_published_faq.name: Is CoinGecko MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 14, 2026, CoinGecko scores 90/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan does not yet meet ChatGPT publishing checks and meets Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: How clear is CoinGecko's MCP tool documentation?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 14, 2026, CoinGecko scores 89/100 in Manufact's review of tool titles, descriptions, input and output schemas, and behavior annotations. The review covers 11 of 11 discovered tools. The quality score measures documentation clarity; runtime behavior and marketplace readiness require separate checks.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the CoinGecko MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: CoinGecko provides these MCP tools: compare-coins, get-categories, get-coin-history, get-coin-info, get-coin-market-chart, get-coin-markets, get-crypto-news, get-global-market, get-top-gainers-losers, get-trending, and search-coins.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to CoinGecko?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to CoinGecko in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.
CoinGecko does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.
CoinGecko is developed by Gecko Labs Pte Ltd. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
